_comment: An EXANTE gateway: one process per EXANTE account owns the two FIX sessions (FEED for quotes, TRADE for orders, with CancelOnDisconnect) and the HTTP API key (polled reads: account summary, positions, orders, fills, fees); the bots lease it. 'network' is demo or live; 'fix_host' the FIX bridge (demo: fixuat2.exante.eu; live: the one EXANTE assigned, e.g. fixprodeu.exante.eu). 'symbols' are EXANTE ids (XAU/USD.E.FX, AAPL.NASDAQ, GC.COMEX.Z2026). 'tif' DAY is what CancelOnDisconnect cancels. EXANTE publishes 25 order requests per 10 s (150 / min): msgs_per_min 138 stays under it; higher (up to 6000) tests what the account gets, and a rate-limit refusal pauses new orders and amends 10 s.
name: exante_demo
